subject: A district officer's cold-weather camp pitched at the edge of a village in north India. A white ridge tent with its flaps tied back, a folding table of papers weighted with a stone, and the Englishman seated on a camp chair in shirtsleeves hearing a dispute between two cultivators, listening carefully with his head tilted. His clerk sits cross-legged on a rug at his side with the register. A crowd of villagers stands at a respectful distance, one of them holding a goat on a rope. Horses tethered at the left, a cook's fire and brass pots at the right, a mango tree above. Early morning in the cold weather.
